'''Jiuri''' is a Black Shore's NPC located at the [[Modulation Hall]], and can be found with [[Huanliu]] and [[Schubert]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Jiuri}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the quest [[Advance toward the Future from Today]])
:'''[[Constantine]]:''' If we keep scanning Tethys' memory, we can pinpoint the Shorekeeper's exact location.
:'''Constantine:''' We won't... ever give up on anyone.
:'''Jiuri:''' Her physical form may be lost in the Matrix, but she is still in there.
:'''Jiuri:''' Because her entire frequency spectrum is still somewhere in Tethys
:{{DIcon}}: The law of conversation?
:'''Constantine:''' Yes! Hmm... so you're familiar with this concept, it's quite significant. 
:'''Constantine:''' If we can recover her frequencies, we can use Tethys to bring her back.
:'''Jiuri:''' It'll be like finding a needle in a haystack...
:'''Constantine:''' She believed in {{Rover}}. So, please trust us as well!
----
;(After {{Quest|Beyond the Shore's End}})
:'''Jiuri:''' Confirm with the Eye of Asteria if the Reverberation samples from the New Federation have been compiled.
:'''Jiuri:''' The Stellar Navigator team is ready. Prepare to simulate Lament-stricken areas on the Sand Table.
:'''Schubert:''' Reverberation data received. Searching for logic units within Tethys for Sand Table simulation.
:'''Schubert:''' Sand Table coordinates confirmed. Proceed to detect bad sectors... Negative. Simulation commencing.
:'''Huanliu:''' Reverberation data loaded. Simulating pre-Lament conditions.
:'''Huanliu:''' Given that the Waveworn occurred decades ago, Reverberations in this area are severely depleted, affecting simulation accuracy. 
:'''Huanliu:''' Success rate: 60%. Jiuri, please request additional computing power from the Matrices.
:'''Jiuri:''' Understood.
{{Dialogue End}}
